literal: By sweet words, affection having mingled, deceit free from being, [is] the word from the mouth of those who have realized the ultimate truth.
translation: A sweet word is speech from the mouth of those who have realized the ultimate truth, mingled with love and free from all deceit.
modern: மெய்ப்பொருளை உணர்ந்தவர்களின் வாயிலிருந்து வரும் சொற்கள், அன்போடு கலந்து, வஞ்சனை இல்லாத இனிய சொற்களாக இருக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true nature of sweet speech. It states that genuine sweet words are those spoken by people who have realized the ultimate truth of life. Their speech is naturally infused with sincere love and affection, and is completely free from any form of deceit or hypocrisy. Thus, true sweetness in language is not mere flattery, but a reflection of inner realization and heartfelt compassion.
